messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Doctors also prescribe gabapentin off-label for other types of nerve pain, including diabetic nerve pain (diabetic neuropathy), and for anxiety, fibromyalgia, hot flashes, and alcohol withdrawal. Off-label means that the condition it is being prescribed for is not an FDA-approved indication.
Triplet: ["Gabapentin", "used for", "hot flashes"]

The relation 'used for' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is prescribed or utilized to treat or manage the medical condition specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
B. 'used in': The subject drug is utilized in the medical procedure or clinical context specified by the object entity.
C. 'used after': The subject drug is typically used following the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.
D. 'reduces risk of': The subject drug is used to prevent or lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.
E. 'belongs to drug class': The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological or therapeutic drug class specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
